text:
Jamie: :wave: FYI — Tariffly just sent invoice 2026-02-TAR-349 and it looks like we were billed for the pilot month and the renewal period (overlap). Link: https://tariffly.example/invoices/2026-02-TAR-349. Who owns negotiation for credits and can we move them to consolidated quarterly billing?
Erin: Can you paste the invoice lines? we need the PO number and which contract this maps to. If it's double-billed we should ask for a pro-rated credit but need vendor contract/PO to back it. cc @Priya from procurement. :mag_right:
Jamie: invoice lines: 
```
Item: Tariffly cloud credits - Pilot Feb 2026 - $8,450
Item: Tariffly committed renewal Mar 2026 - $12,300
Tax/fees: $0
Total: $20,750
PO: PO-98762
```
Priya: Thanks — I’ll open a ticket with Tariffly. Our playbook: request pro-rata credit for overlapped pilot month, propose switching to consolidated quarterly billing with payments on the 1st of quarter. Need confirmation of desired effective date and an estimate of impact to cash flow. Jamie — is quarterly starting May 1 ok?
Matt: Confirmed usage spike in late Feb was from the stress test, not ongoing prod traffic. I can attach the runbook + timestamped logs if they push back. We should include the usage query results in the dispute.
billing-bot: Invoice 2026-02-TAR-349 (PO-98762) uploaded: https://files.redwood/invoices/2026-02-TAR-349.pdf :page_facing_up:
procurement-bot: Ticket created: TKT-5832 — "Tariffly: overlap billing dispute + request for quarterly consolidation". Assigned to Priya. SLA target 72h.
Priya: @Lena can we route this for expedited approval? Proposed remedy: (1) pro-rated credit >= $12k for overlap, (2) billing cadence amendment to quarterly starting 2026-05-01, (3) amendment signed by legal. If legal OK, procurement will accept a credit note in place of refund.
Lena: Approved in principle. If Tariffly issues a credit note >= $12,000 and amends billing cadence, finance signs off. Please CC legal (legal@redwood.ai) on the amendment. Priya — route contract amendment + credit note to my inbox for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Jamie: great — I’ll paste the stress-test logs and include a quick timeline in the ticket. Thanks everyone, please ping if Tariffly asks for anything else. :pray:
Priya: Will do. Tracking here TKT-5832; target to close before Apr 10 to avoid manual accounting headaches.
Jamie: tagging closing owners: @Priya (procurement), @Lena (finance approver), @Matt (usage verification).
